what: A thin curve is drawn to the end over 3.6s power4.inOut, then immediately erased from the front in 1.4s, while the whole line drifts sideways from −60 to 60px. Rests 8 seconds, then repeats. Like an ECG line passing over a photo

options.when: With view, it starts when it reaches 80% of the screen (default: immediately)

use: <svg data-fx="line-draw-loop" data-fx-line-draw-loop="draw: 3; erase: 1; when: view" viewBox="0 0 1400 300"><path d="…"/></svg>
note: Original is for erasing "power4.Out"(uppercase) was used, so GSAP can’t find the curve and falls back to the default power1.out — matching the visible motion, power1.out.
